name: Events.com Discover

sources.title: Discover homepage — 186M+ events worldwide; 'Create an event' links to promote.events.com organizer flow

requirements: This is an events marketplace, NOT a product directory — the only listing type is an actual event (online events/webinars count)
Organizer account on Events.com (Log In / Sign Up on discover.events.com, event creation via promote.events.com/user/organize/draft)
A real event with date, location/virtual format, description — fake 'product launch' spam events risk removal
preparation: A legitimate event concept tied to the product (launch webinar, demo day, AMA)
Event title, date/time, timezone, virtual or physical location
Event description, cover image, ticket type (free tickets avoid platform fee questions)
workflow: Create an Events.com organizer account via the Log In / Sign Up flow
Fill event details (title, date, virtual/physical, description, image)
Publish — the event is indexed on discover.events.com by city and category (Music, Business, etc.)
watchFor: Only useful if the launch includes a real event — a SaaS product with no event has nothing to list
Paid-ticket events may carry platform fees (not verified); free events are the safe route
Batch seed 'discover.events.com' submission URL just points at events.com main site — the real route is the organizer dashboard
Event listings expire after the event date
countsAsLive: The event page is publicly reachable on discover.events.com and appears in its city/category listings before the event date
unknowns: Ticketing fee structure for paid tickets
Whether event pages carry dofollow external links
